message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **Canadian federal public holidays that create “long weekends”** (i.e., a holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday, giving you a three‑day weekend) for the calendar year 2023.  
(If you’re in a province that observes additional holidays—e.g., Family Day in Alberta, St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.—you’ll want to add those separately.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend? | Notes |
|---------|-------------|-------------|---------------|-------|
| **Family Day** (Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, New Brunswick, Manitoba, Ontario) | **Feb 20** | Monday | ✔ | Creates a long weekend from **Feb 18–20**. |
| **Good Friday** | **Apr 7** | Friday | ✔ | Creates a long weekend from **Apr 7–9**. |
| **Victoria Day** | **May 22** | Monday | ✔ | Creates a long weekend from **May 20–22**. |
| **Labour Day** | **Sep 4** | Monday | ✔ | Creates a long weekend from **Sep 2–4**. |
| **Thanksgiving** | **Oct 9** | Monday | ✔ | Creates a long weekend from **Oct 7–9**. |
| **Remembrance Day** | **Nov 11** | Monday | ✔ | Creates a long weekend from **Nov 9–11**. |
| **Christmas Day** | **Dec 25** | Monday | ✔ | Creates a long weekend from **Dec 23–25**. |

### Quick‑look calendar view

```
Jan 2023
 1 (Sun) – New Year’s Day (no long weekend)
 2 (Mon) – Observed New Year’s Day (if you’re in a province that observes it)

Feb 2023
 20 (Mon) – Family Day (long weekend Feb 18–20)

Apr 2023
 7 (Fri) – Good Friday (long weekend Apr 7–9)

May 2023
 22 (Mon) – Victoria Day (long weekend May 20–22)

Sep 2023
 4 (Mon) – Labour Day (long weekend Sep 2–4)

Oct 2023
 9 (Mon) – Thanksgiving (long weekend Oct 7–9)

Nov 2023
 11 (Mon) – Remembrance Day (long weekend Nov 9–11)

Dec 2023
 25 (Mon) – Christmas Day (long weekend Dec 23–25)
```

> **Tip for your app:**  
> If you want to support *observed* holidays (e.g., when a holiday falls on a weekend and the following Monday is a holiday), you can add logic to shift the holiday to the nearest weekday. For example, New Year’s Day 2023 falls on Sunday, so many provinces observe it on Monday, Jan 2, creating a long weekend from Dec 31 – Jan 2.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like province‑specific holidays or a more detailed breakdown!
